title: WordPress: a template part's button labels are written in the site's one language; EmDash: a menu item leading to a page that keeps the template's title is never relabelled
steps: S1: No stand and no site. From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-name-pattern="buttons of its parts|title stays the template" apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-emdash.test.mjs

S2: brief-wordpress runs the WordPress brief engine against a fake Vietnamese site whose header part holds a named core/button 'Subscribe' (as JA Essence 1.0.10 ships it), and against an English site with the same button.
S3: brief-emdash runs seedMenus over the real Tracy Business seed, with no language and with vi-VN.
S4: Read the node:test summary lines (tests / pass / fail) and every failing test name.
expect: Vietnamese site: 'Subscribe' is among the labels put to the judge, the header part reads the judge's label and the block keeps metadata.name header.subscribe; English site: the button is not judged and keeps 'Subscribe'.
Tracy Business: topbar 'Investors' and footer 'Investor relations' (page /investors, title not rewritten) are not planned; 'Careers', 'About' and the footer services still are.

selectors.seam: judging / sweepWordPress in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/wordpress.js and wp-residue.js (buttonLabels, relabelButtons); seedMenus / leadsToKeptTitle in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/emdash-menus.js
selectors.door: the menu-label judge (fake model in the tests); content.update of the template part; the EmDash menu planner input

evidence: Dev (cowork.tracy.site), 10/10/2026, step 5.5 re-verify: g56-ess-wp-full (JA Essence WP 1.0.10, Vietnamese) printed the header button 'Subscribe' -> /contact on /, /contact/, /detail/layout-1/, /home/home-2/ (LANG-2); g56-biz-emd-full (Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.4, Vietnamese) labelled the topbar link to /investors 'Gia đình' while the page is titled 'Quan hệ nhà đầu tư' (PAGE-5).
fence: Unit tests with a fake site and a fake model over the real Tracy Business seed; no live WordPress or EmDash site and no model ran. Dev sites made before the deploy keep their words.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=buttons of its parts|title stays the template
